description: Kharigan wears a long olive-grey crossed-front steppe robe with brown and blue geometric woven borders along its diagonal closure, sleeve cuffs and bottom edge. A cream crossed-collar underlayer is visible at the throat. A broad patterned brown sash wraps the waist several times, with a long fringed end hanging down. Brown leather-like cuff layers show at the wrists. Loose brown trousers are tucked into tall soft brown boots. The robe has a felted or wool-like textured surface, and exact fibers cannot be established. Clothing is opaque, practical and restrained; no headgear, armor, weapon or oversized fur display is visible.
